switch_delete_after_reading_note: A chapter you finish in the reader is deleted from this Switch when the reader closes. Bookmarked chapters stay.
delete_after_reading_note: A chapter you finish in the reader loses its download on the server. Bookmarked chapters keep theirs. Other apps using this server see it gone too.
source_wait_note: How long the app waits when the server has to ask a source's website: browsing a source, refreshing a manga, opening a chapter. Choose more if your server passes Cloudflare checks with FlareSolverr.
safe_on: On: the app closed unexpectedly last time
